newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures close steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures close steady to higher.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed steady to higher on Thursday, reflecting a firmer Chicago corn market and the yen's weaker tone against the dollar, traders said.
Prices were unchanged to 150 yen higher, with the benchmark May 1998 contract steady at 15,790 yen per tonne. The day's volume was 29,077 lots.

The market gained during the morning session on light buying from local investors, but distant months failed to rise as technical selling capped the topside, traders said. Trading was quiet due to Japan's "Golden Week" holidays, they said.
The spot May contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was trading at $2.95 per bushel at 0715 GMT, unchanged from Wednesday's close.
Spot May CBOT soybean futures were at $8.91 a bushel, up from $8.89-1/2 at Wednesday's close.
